dashboard.welcome: The application foundation is running. Business modules are added phase by phase.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your work account.
login.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
login.recoveryHint: Format XXXX-XXXX. After signing in you must enable 2FA again.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Use a password only you know.
password.forcedSubtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Create a new password to continue.
password.policy: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
password.needsLetterDigit: Password must contain letters and digits.
password.mismatch: New password and repeat do not match.

totp.title: Enable 2FA
totp.subtitle: Your role requires two-step verification.
totp.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar).
totp.step2: Scan the QR code below, or enter the key manually.
totp.step3: Enter the 6 digits shown in the app.
totp.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app

roles.intro: System roles can have their permissions edited but cannot be deleted. Custom roles can be created, cloned and deactivated. Changes apply immediately.
roles.caption: Roles
roles.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore. Cannot be changed.
roles.name: Role name
roles.viewAsHelp: Read-only preview: visible menus and sensitive data access. No session is created; recorded in the audit trail.
roles.matrixHelp: Each cell: data scope for that action (Own, Department, Project, All) or – for no permission.
roles.savedNow: Permissions saved; they apply to the next request.
roles.temporaryHelp: E.g. cover during leave. Revoked automatically after the end date.

workflow.bulkNeedsType: Pick one document type to approve in bulk.
workflow.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
workflow.rejectedOne: {{number}} rejected and returned to the requester.
workflow.rejectHelp: The document returns to Draft. Say what the requester must fix.
workflow.withdrawHelp: The submission is cancelled and the document returns to Draft.

delegation.help: During the period the delegate may approve on your behalf. Every action is logged.
delegation.searchUser: Type a name or email (min. 2 letters)

doa.intro: Approval rules per document type. Rules are checked in order; the first match applies. Changes take effect after Director approval.
doa.editHelp: The change is sent to the Director and applies only after approval.
doa.name: Rule name
doa.nestedReadOnly: nested condition, change via system admin
doa.reasonHint: At least 5 characters; shown to the Director.
doa.submitted: Change submitted as {{number}}, awaiting Director approval.

master.empty: No data yet. Add rows one by one or import a CSV.
master.sensitiveHint: Personal data (PDP law); visible only with permission.
master.importHelp: Download the template, fill it in Excel, save as CSV. Rows with an existing code are updated. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
master.importFailed: {{count}} problems found. Nothing was saved; fix them and import again.

dms.rules: PDF, JPG or PNG, max. 20 MB

settings.more: Other settings (company profile, users, roles) arrive in phase 01a.
settings.demoHelp: Sample data to try the application. Every demo row is flagged and can be removed at once; configuration (COA, roles, DOA rules) stays.
settings.demoConfirmHelp: This cannot be undone and is recorded in the audit trail. Type {{word}} to continue.
settings.emailHelp: Send a test email to your address to check the configuration (EMAIL_PROVIDER, SMTP or Resend).

setup.subtitle: First-run setup of Nustrad ERP. Done only once.
setup.tokenMissing: SETUP_TOKEN is not set on the server. Ask IT to set it, then reload this page.
setup.strongPolicy: At least 12 characters with upper case, lower case, digit and symbol.
setup.resumeHelp: The Super Admin exists. Sign in to continue.
setup.totpHelp: 2FA is mandatory for the Super Admin. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digits.
setup.fixedHint: Currency IDR, time zone Asia/Jakarta, Indonesian language.
setup.logoLater: The GEK logo for documents can be uploaded later in Settings.
setup.deptHelp: The list is prefilled; edit, remove or add. Each department gets a cost center.
setup.demoHelp: Load demo data to try the application (can be removed at once later), or start empty.
setup.finishHelp: After finishing, the setup page closes for good and other users can be invited.
setup.doneHelp: The setup page is closed and cannot be opened again.

recovery.help: Store these 10 codes somewhere safe (e.g. a password vault). Each code signs you in once if your authenticator phone is lost. They will not be shown again.
recovery.confirm: I have saved my recovery codes
recovery.fileHeader: Nustrad ERP 2FA recovery codes — PT Global Energi KITA. Each code works once.

users.inviteSent: Invitation sent to {{email}}. The link is valid for 72 hours.

mode.invite: Email an invitation link (72 hours, single use)
mode.password: Temporary password (shown once, must be changed)

users.tempOnce: Temporary password, shown only once. Give it to the user directly; it must be changed at sign-in.
users.employeeHint: Link to the HR employee record.
users.caption: Users
users.oneSuperAdmin: There is only one active Super Admin. Add a second one so access is not lost if this account is locked.

done.invite: New invitation sent; the old link no longer works.
done.reset-2fa: 2FA reset; the user must enrol again.
done.force-logout: All sessions of the user ended.

users.importHelp: CSV or Excel with columns email, full_name, roles (codes separated by |), department_code, employee_code. Every new user gets an email invitation. If any row is wrong, nothing is saved.
users.acceptHelp: Create a password for your Nustrad ERP account.
users.linkNotEmailed: Email is not configured. Copy this activation link and give it to the user directly (valid 72 hours, single use).

onboarding.privacySubtitle: Under Law 27/2022 on Personal Data Protection.
onboarding.privacyRead: I have read the privacy notice
onboarding.profileSubtitle: Used in approvals and documents you sign.
onboarding.signatureHint: Optional now; needed for documents you sign. PNG on white.

tour.welcomeBody: You are signed in as {{roles}}. Menus and buttons follow your roles.
tour.menuBody: On the left: {{groups}}. Items marked "Soon" activate once their module is built.
tour.approvalsBody: Documents waiting for your decision are in My Approvals (count in the menu). The bell at the top right holds notifications, including certificates about to expire.
tour.helpBody: Switch active role, theme, language and password from your name menu at the top right. Access problems? Contact IT Admin.

sod.title: Segregation of duties
sod.intro: Role pairs that one person must not hold. A conflicting combination needs a reason and Director approval, is recorded in the register and reviewed monthly by the Lead Controller.
sod.conflictHelp: Give a reason to request an exception from the Director. The new roles apply after approval.

accessReview.intro: Quarterly review: every active user with roles, sensitive data access and last login. Users without a login for more than {{days}} days are flagged.
accessReview.caption: User access review

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your work email. We will send a link to create a new password.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Create a new password for your account.
reset.done: Password updated. All old sessions were ended; please sign in again.
reset.noToken: The link is incomplete. Open the link from the email or request a new one.

crm.clientHint: Leave empty for a new prospect.
crm.qualifyHint: Meet at least {{min}} criteria to qualify.
crm.fromLeadHint: Opportunities are created from qualified leads ("Turn into opportunity").
crm.bidPendingNote: The bid/no-bid decision is waiting for the Director; the stage cannot change until decided.
crm.qualifiedHint: Quotation is reached only through a bid decision approved by the Director.
crm.stageHint: Move the stage as the quotation progresses.
crm.bidHelp: Score six aspects 1–5. A score ≥ {{threshold}}% recommends bid; the Director decides.
crm.justifyHint: The proposal differs from the score recommendation: give a reason (min. 10 characters).
crm.wonHelp: Creates the contract (rate schedule from the quotation after discount) and a draft project (budget from quoted cost + contingency) in one step.
crm.paymentTermHint: Leave empty to use the client's term.
crm.submittedHint: The quotation was sent. Mark won or lost once the client decides.

next.draft: Complete the lines, save, then submit. Margin ≥ 25% goes to the Head of Sales, below that to the Director.
next.approved: Ready to send to the client with an official letter number.
next.rejected: Rejected. Create a revision to fix it.
next.sent: Sent to the client. Create a revision if the client asks for changes.

emailStatus.not_configured: Email is not configured; send the PDF manually.

quotation.title: Quotation
quotation.fromOppHint: Quotations are created from the opportunity page at the Quotation stage.
quotation.lowMarginBanner: Margin {{value}}% is below {{threshold}}%. Check prices and discount before submitting; Director approval is required.
quotation.linesHelp: Add lines from the price database; quantity, cost and price can be edited. Totals and margin are computed by the server on save.
quotation.readOnly: Read-only. Create a revision to change it.
quotation.unsaved: Unsaved changes; the totals above are not updated yet.
quotation.reviseHelp: The new revision copies the lines of this one. The old revision is kept as history.
quotation.sendHelp: Issues letter number 001/GEK-SLS/…, stores the PDF in documents and moves the opportunity to Submitted.
quotation.alsoEmail: Also email the client contact (PDF attached)
quotation.emailNotConfigured: Email is not configured: the letter is still issued, send the PDF manually.
quotation.startHelp: The opportunity is at the Quotation stage. Create a quotation from the price database.

contract.fromWonHint: Contracts are created automatically when an opportunity is marked won.
contract.ratesHelp: From the quotation after discount. Add manual rates: equipment standby/breakdown, personnel per day, consumables (cost + markup), mob/demob.

project.name: Project name
project.budgetHelp: Draft from the quoted cost + {{pct}}% contingency. Read-only; budget editing and locking come in phase 03.
